proposals.evidence: The complete western broken-state phrase is bhāg-/broken + gone. Turner’s bhagna branch explicitly includes Gujarati bhāgũ broken and bhāgvũ break; gata supplies gay-/gy-. This is distinguished from the nasal bhaṅg- stem and from the related runaway sense.
